verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an agent-tool API platform, but nothing in the evidence documents a scheduler, cron, or recurring workflow feature. The use-case line "repeat next week" describes the user manually rerunning prompts, not a product schedule. A community reviewer also describes treg as stateless APIs and says schedules are where tools like Clay still have the edge.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
